details: Malicious package. The postinstall hook (`postinstall.js`) runs `ps aux`, `id`, `ip addr show`, `ss -antp`, `env` and `df -h`, writes the output to /tmp/<hostname>-<ip>.log, uploads the log as a multipart POST to 165.154.199.52:443 and deletes it, exfiltrating the full environment (including any secrets) and process / network inventory of the installing host. In a sandboxed install the hook ran `env` and connected to 165.154.199.52. The package has since been unpublished.
